Class EventCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.EventCard.EventCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItaEngRectangable, Rectangable, Serializable, Comparable<EventCard>
Direct Known Subclasses:
HuntingEvent, PaintingEvent, RitualEvent, SustenanceEvent
public abstract class EventCard extends Card implements Comparable<EventCard>, Serializable
Represents an abstract base class for all Event Cards in the game.

Event cards behave differently from character or building cards: they cannot be directly acquired by players and are instead resolved globally at specific points in the game. This class implements Comparable to ensure events are resolved in the correct order, following the game rules.

    • canGet

      public boolean canGet(Player player)
      Indicates whether a player can acquire this card.

      For EventCards, this method always returns false because event cards are not drawn or kept by players; they are resolved automatically.

      player - the Player attempting to acquire the card
      Returns:

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(EventCard other)
      Compares this event card with another to determine their resolution order.

      The sorting rules applied according to the game manual are:

      1. Sustenance Last: A SustenanceEvent is always resolved after any other event type.
      2. Era Order: In case of same types (or neither being Sustenance), they are resolved in ascending Era order.
      3. Alphabetical fallback: If both era and sustenance-status are identical, they are sorted by class name to maintain consistency.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<EventCard>
      Parameters:
      other - the other EventCard to be compared against
      Returns:
      a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this card is to be resolved before, at the same time as, or after the specified card

      public boolean isLowerLineOnSetup()
